response.text:
We can’t force it on ourselves, it has to come from a place of understanding or it’s just bypassing. But if we never forgive them and just stay in the anger, then we’re letting the injury run how we move in the present. It’s just like everything – we can hold it all. It can all be true. Yes they hurt us, yes they still have to answer for hurting us, yes we still have to maintain a certain boundary with them, and yes one day we might find we’ve forgiven them (or at least we’re not moving in resentment towards them anymore). But we don’t have to do that stuff in order to be safe, put our boundaries up, hold them accountable, get justice, get better, etc.

In essence they could only make the moves they made based on where they were at in their accumulated nature at that time. That doesn’t mean that we can’t still be hurt by the moves they made, or that we can’t still hold them accountable for those moves, or allow for consequences of those moves, or work to make different moves now, etc. It just allows us to not expect things from them that they may not be able to make. That doesn’t mean that those things aren’t important.

We don’t have to do it until we’re ready. I’m not trying to spiritiualize away your pain. But we also don’t have to make our life be all about that pain forever.
